Consistent 3 decision points throughout
Highly manageable for substitute teachers

Simple materials lists and setup

Vocabulary builds naturally (voix → partager → geste → émotion → spectacle)
14 core lessons systematically develop oral communication skills
6 extensions provide meaningful advanced practice
Strong connections between lessons with clear building
